Hi there, and thanks for contacting Leafy! 🌿

Great question. Unfortunately, promo codes can't be stacked with Leafy Plus member pricing on the same item. Here's how it works:

- **Only one discount applies per item.** If you have a promo code and Plus member pricing (10% off pots and accessories) on the same pot, the better of the two discounts is applied automatically, so you don't need to do anything.
- **Promo codes are limited to one per order**, and they can't be added after you've already placed the order.

So you'll always get the stronger deal on each item. If your promo code is worth more than 10% on a pot, the code applies. If not, your member price does.

Is there anything else I can help you with, such as picking out pots or sorting out your order? Feel free to reach out any time. Happy planting! 🪴
